description: Rail Intercity Stations is a dataset listed in Metropolitan Transportation Commission open data portal (data.bayareametro.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Metropolitan Transportation Commission. Intercity passenger rail services provide transportation between metropolitan areas, to rural areas of California, and to points beyond California’s borders. Coverage: San Francisco Bay Area. The portal files it under the category Infrastructure. Its tags are baaqmd-mdm, baaqmd-opendata, rail, baaqmd. The table has 19 columns. Attribution on the portal: Caltrans, Division of Rail and Mass Transit. The portal shows 2022-03-02 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-bayareametro-gov-portal.
